section.title: org.osgi.service.repository
section.para: Repository Service Package Version 1.1.

section.title: public final class ContentNamespace extends Namespace
section.para: Content Capability and Requirement Namespace.

This class defines the names for the attributes and directives for this namespace. All unspecified capability attributes are of type String and are used as arbitrary matching attributes for the capability. The values associated with the specified directive and attribute keys are of type String, unless otherwise indicated.

formalpara.title: Concurrency
formalpara.para: Immutable

section.title: public static final String CAPABILITY_MIME_ATTRIBUTE = "mime"
section.para: The capability attribute that defines the IANA MIME Type/Format for this content.

section.title: public static final String CAPABILITY_SIZE_ATTRIBUTE = "size"
section.para: The capability attribute that contains the size, in bytes, of the content. The value of this attribute must be of type Long.

section.title: public static final String CAPABILITY_URL_ATTRIBUTE = "url"
section.para: The capability attribute that contains the URL to the content.

section.title: public static final String CONTENT_NAMESPACE = "osgi.content"
section.para: Namespace name for content capabilities and requirements.
Also, the capability attribute used to specify the unique identifier of the content. This identifier is the SHA-256 hash of the content.

section.title: public interface Repository
section.para: A repository service that contains resources.
Repositories may be registered as services and may be used as by a resolve context during resolver operations.
Repositories registered as services may be filtered using standard service properties.

formalpara.title: Concurrency
formalpara.para: Thread-safe

formalpara.title: Provider Type
formalpara.para: Consumers of this API must not implement this type

section.title: public static final String URL = "repository.url"
section.para: Service property to provide URLs related to this repository.
The value of this property must be of type String, String[], or Collection<String>.

section.title: public Map<Requirement, Collection<Capability>> findProviders(Collection<? extends Requirement> requirements)

formalpara.title: requirements
formalpara.para: The requirements for which matching capabilities should be returned. Must not be null.

section.para: Find the capabilities that match the specified requirements.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: A map of matching capabilities for the specified requirements. Each specified requirement must appear as a key in the map. If there are no matching capabilities for a specified requirement, then the value in the map for the specified requirement must be an empty collection. The returned map is the property of the caller and can be modified by the caller. The returned map may be lazily populated, so calling size() may result in a long running operation.

section.title: public Promise<Collection<Resource>> findProviders(RequirementExpression expression)

formalpara.title: expression
formalpara.para: The RequirementExpression for which matching capabilities should be returned. Must not be null.

section.para: Find the resources that match the specified requirement expression.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: A promise to a collection of matching Resources. If there are no matching resources, an empty collection is returned. The returned collection is the property of the caller and can be modified by the caller. The returned collection may be lazily populated, so calling size() may result in a long running operation.

section.title: public interface RepositoryContent
section.para:
An accessor for the content of a resource.
All Resource objects which represent resources in a Repository must implement this interface. A user of the resource can then cast the Resource object to this type and then obtain an InputStream to the content of the resource.

formalpara.title: Concurrency
formalpara.para: Thread-safe

formalpara.title: Provider Type
formalpara.para: Consumers of this API must not implement this type

section.title: public InputStream getContent()
section.para: Returns a new input stream to the content of this resource. The content is represented on the resource through the osgi.content capability. If more than one such capability is associated with the resource, the first such capability is returned.

formalpara.title: Returns
formalpara.para: A new input stream for associated content.
